marks.name: Three options, not a dial
marks.why: Agora charges the same $0.10 a minute whichever stack you pick, so there was one real axis and a slider had nothing to dial. Each option says what it is for and carries its own answer time.

marks.name: One price for all three
marks.why: It becomes a figure only when a slot leaves the Agora Managed Key, which is the one place a stack choice changes the bill.

name: after9-template-dialog
pre: (async()=>{document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');document.documentElement.style.colorScheme='light';const wait=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const key=(el,k)=>el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:k,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));await wait(1500);const chip=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent.includes('Template:'));if(chip){chip.focus();key(chip,'Enter');}await wait(900);for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const it=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=menuitem]')];const cur=it.find(x=>/Appointment/i.test(x.textContent));if(cur){cur.focus();key(cur,'Enter');break;}key(document.activeElement||document.body,'ArrowDown');await wait(200);}await wait(1600);})()

marks.name: Content stays inside the panel
marks.why: Every row was a flex with no minimum-width reset, so the greeting and the extract list pushed straight through the panel edge. They are two-column grids now, and the primitive stops any grid child from outgrowing its dialog.
